terms.sale record: One fixture event with a sale ID, book ID, sale date, and quantity.
terms.week_start: Monday of the ISO-style calendar week containing sold_date.

business_rules: Each row is one sale record, not an aggregate bucket.
Rows add title, author, genre, weekday, week_start, and month from local book/date data.
Total units cover all rows matching filters, not only the returned page.
examples: For an individual ledger use get_sales; for a monthly series use get_sales_trends.
